+"""Provenance: CamCraft's guide navigation and preserved public URLs (#1903)."""
+
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+from pathlib import Path
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urljoin, urlsplit
+import unittest
+
+
+SITE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+BASE = "https://example.test/Camcraft"
+GROUPS = [
+    ("getting-started", "Getting started"),
+    ("set-up", "Set up the job"),
+    ("operations", "Operations"),
+    ("check-and-post", "Check and post"),
+    ("multi-axis", "Multi-axis"),
+    ("automate", "Automate"),
+    ("reference", "Reference"),
+    ("fundamentals", "CAM fundamentals"),
+]
+MOVED = {
+    "getting-started": ["install", "first-run", "keyboard-and-mouse", "workflows"],
+    "set-up": ["setups", "workholding", "tools"],
+    "operations": ["operations-2d", "operations-3d", "operations-probing",
+                   "operations-turning", "operations-plasma", "operations-edm"],
+    "check-and-post": ["order-of-operations", "posting", "machines"],
+    "multi-axis": ["operations-multiaxis"],
+    "automate": ["cli", "mcp"],
+    "reference": ["units-and-coordinates", "glossary", "refusals",
+                  "troubleshooting", "migrating"],
+}
+
+
+class Document(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self, source):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.stack = []
+        self.links = []
+        self.groups = []
+        self.expanded_groups = []
+        self.current_links = []
+        self.sidebar_links = []
+        self.ids = set()
+        self.refresh = None
+        self.text = []
+        self.anchor = None
+        self.feed(source)
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        attrs = dict(attrs)
+        if attrs.get("id"):
+            self.ids.add(attrs["id"])
+        if tag == "meta" and attrs.get("http-equiv", "").lower() == "refresh":
+            self.refresh = attrs.get("content", "")
+        if tag == "a":
+            self.anchor = [attrs, [], any(
+                name == "nav" and values.get("aria-label") == "User guide"
+                for name, values in self.stack
+            )]
+        if tag not in {"area", "base", "br", "col", "embed", "hr", "img",
+                       "input", "link", "meta", "param", "source", "track", "wbr"}:
+            self.stack.append((tag, attrs))
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag == "a" and self.anchor is not None:
+            attrs, parts, in_sidebar = self.anchor
+            link = (attrs.get("href", ""), "".join(parts).strip())
+            self.links.append(link)
+            if in_sidebar:
+                self.sidebar_links.append(link)
+                if attrs.get("aria-current") == "page":
+                    self.current_links.append(link[0])
+                if "guide-group-link" in attrs.get("class", "").split():
+                    self.groups.append(link)
+                    if any(name == "details" and "open" in values
+                           for name, values in self.stack):
+                        self.expanded_groups.append(link[0])
+            self.anchor = None
+        for i in range(len(self.stack) - 1, -1, -1):
+            if self.stack[i][0] == tag:
+                del self.stack[i:]
+                break
+
+    def handle_data(self, data):
+        self.text.append(data)
+        if self.anchor is not None:
+            self.anchor[1].append(data)
+
+
+class GuideNavigation(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.directory.cleanup)
+        cls.output = Path(cls.directory.name) / "public"
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [os.environ.get("ZOLA", "zola"), "build", "--base-url", BASE,
+             "--output-dir", str(cls.output)],
+            cwd=SITE, capture_output=True, text=True,
+        )
+        if result.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(result.stdout + result.stderr)
+
+    def read(self, path):
+        file = self.output / path / "index.html"
+        self.assertTrue(file.is_file(), f"Missing built page: {path}")
+        return Document(file.read_text())
+
+    def test_sidebar_groups_follow_a_job_on_every_guide_page(self):
+        expected = [(f"{BASE}/guide/{slug}/", title) for slug, title in GROUPS]
+        pages = ["guide"]
+        pages.extend(f"guide/{slug}" for slug, _ in GROUPS)
+        pages.extend(f"guide/{group}/{slug}" for group, slugs in MOVED.items()
+                     for slug in slugs)
+        pages.extend(f"guide/{section}/{path.stem}"
+                     for section in ("fundamentals", "multi-axis")
+                     for path in (SITE / "content/guide" / section).glob("*.md")
+                     if path.stem != "_index")
+        for page in pages:
+            with self.subTest(page=page):
+                document = self.read(page)
+                self.assertEqual(document.groups, expected)
+                self.assertEqual(document.current_links, [f"{BASE}/{page}/"])
+                active_group = [url for url, _ in expected
+                                if f"{BASE}/{page}/".startswith(url)]
+                self.assertEqual(document.expanded_groups, active_group)
+
+    def test_section_indexes_and_sidebar_reach_every_moved_page(self):
+        root = self.read("guide")
+        for group, slugs in MOVED.items():
+            section = self.read(f"guide/{group}")
+            for slug in slugs:
+                with self.subTest(page=slug):
+                    url = f"{BASE}/guide/{group}/{slug}/"
+                    self.assertIn(url, [href for href, _ in section.links])
+                    self.assertIn(url, [href for href, _ in root.sidebar_links])
+
+    def test_old_urls_redirect_to_the_relocated_pages(self):
+        for group, slugs in MOVED.items():
+            for slug in slugs:
+                with self.subTest(page=slug):
+                    old = self.read(f"guide/{slug}")
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(old.refresh, "Old URL needs a redirect alias")
+                    match = re.search(r"url\s*=\s*(.+)", old.refresh, re.I)
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(match)
+                    self.assertEqual(match.group(1).strip(" '\""),
+                                     f"{BASE}/guide/{group}/{slug}/")
+                    self.assertIsNone(self.read(f"guide/{group}/{slug}").refresh)
+        # The overview becomes the section index, retaining its URL and anchors.
+        overview = self.read("guide/operations")
+        self.assertIsNone(overview.refresh)
+        self.assertIn("checking", overview.ids)
+        self.assertIn("generating", overview.ids)
+
+    def test_guide_index_has_a_start_here_path(self):
+        root = self.read("guide")
+        self.assertIn("start here", " ".join(root.text).lower())
+        for path in ("getting-started/first-run", "set-up", "operations", "check-and-post"):
+            self.assertIn(f"{BASE}/guide/{path}/", [href for href, _ in root.links])
+
+    def test_built_internal_links_and_anchors_resolve(self):
+        for file in self.output.rglob("*.html"):
+            relative = file.relative_to(self.output).as_posix()
+            source_url = f"{BASE}/{relative}"
+            document = Document(file.read_text())
+            for href, _ in document.links:
+                target = urlsplit(urljoin(source_url, href))
+                if target.netloc != "example.test":
+                    continue
+                with self.subTest(source=relative, href=href):
+                    self.assertTrue(target.path.startswith("/Camcraft/"),
+                                    "Internal link lost the deployment prefix")
+                    path = self.output / unquote(target.path.removeprefix("/Camcraft/"))
+                    if path.is_dir():
+                        path /= "index.html"
+                    self.assertTrue(path.is_file(), f"Missing link target: {path}")
+                    if target.fragment and path.suffix == ".html":
+                        self.assertIn(unquote(target.fragment), Document(path.read_text()).ids)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Pin the operation reference pictures against the public operation enum.
+
+Provenance: CamCraft's own OpType and guide sections; no vendor material.
+"""
+
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+from pathlib import Path

+import re
+import subprocess

+from urllib.parse import urljoin
+import unittest
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+SITE = ROOT / "site"
+SVG = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
+FAMILIES = {
+    "2d": {
+        "Face": "Face", "Contour": "2D Contour", "Pocket": "2D Pocket",
+        "Adaptive2D": "2D Adaptive", "Offset2D": "2D Offset", "Slot": "Slot",

+        "Contour5D": "5-Axis Contour", "Parallel5D": "5-Axis Parallel",
+        "Flow5D": "5-Axis Flow", "MultiAxisContour": "Multi-Axis Contour",
+        "Swarf": "Swarf", "AdvancedSwarf": "Advanced Swarf",
+        "RotaryContour": "Rotary Contour", "RotaryParallel": "Rotary Parallel",

+        "GrooveFinish": "Groove Finish", "Part": "Part", "Threading": "Threading",
+        "Chamfering": "Chamfer", "TaperTurning": "Taper",
+        "MultiPassTurning": "Multi-Pass", "FormTurning": "Form", "BoringTurning": "Bore",
+    },
+    "probing": {"Probe": "Probe"},

+        "WireContour": "Wire Contour", "SinkerBurn": "Sinker Burn",
+        "SinkerSideBurn": "Sinker Side Burn",
+    },
+}
+
+
+class OperationReferencePictures(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_every_operation_has_section_and_picture(self):
+        source = (ROOT / "crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs").read_text()
+        enum = source.split("pub enum OpType {", 1)[1].split("\n}", 1)[0]
+        kinds = set(re.findall(r"^    ([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*),$", enum, re.M))
+        documented = {kind for family in FAMILIES.values() for kind in family}
+        self.assertEqual(kinds, documented, "Update the reference when OpType changes")
+        for family, sections in FAMILIES.items():
+            group = "multi-axis" if family == "multiaxis" else "operations"
+            page = SITE / "content/guide" / group / f"operations-{family}.md"
+            parts = re.split(r"^## (.+)$", page.read_text(), flags=re.M)
+            contents = dict(zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]))
+            for kind, heading in sections.items():
+                with self.subTest(kind=kind):
+                    self.assertIn(heading, contents, f"Missing section in {page}")
+                    image = re.search(
+                        rf"!\[([^\]]+)\]\(\.\./\.\./\.\./operation-paths\.svg#{kind}\)",
+                        contents[heading],
+                    )
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(image, f"{heading} needs its toolpath picture")
+                    self.assertGreater(len(image.group(1).split()), 4, "Describe the pictured path")
+
+    def test_generated_picture_urls_preserve_site_prefix(self):
+        class Pictures(HTMLParser):
+            def __init__(self):
+                super().__init__()
+                self.sources = []
+
+            def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+                if tag == "img":
+                    source = dict(attrs).get("src", "")
+                    if "operation-paths.svg" in source:
+                        self.sources.append(source)
+
+        base_url = "https://example.test/Camcraft"
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            output = Path(directory) / "public"
+            subprocess.run(
+                [os.environ.get("ZOLA", "zola"), "build", "--base-url", base_url, "--output-dir", str(output)],
+                cwd=SITE, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
+            )
+            self.assertTrue((output / "operation-paths.svg").is_file())
+            for family, sections in FAMILIES.items():
+                with self.subTest(family=family):
+                    group = "multi-axis" if family == "multiaxis" else "operations"
+                    relative_page = f"guide/{group}/operations-{family}/"
+                    parser = Pictures()
+                    parser.feed((output / relative_page / "index.html").read_text())
+                    resolved = [urljoin(f"{base_url}/{relative_page}", src)
+                                for src in parser.sources]
+                    expected = [f"{base_url}/operation-paths.svg#{kind}" for kind in sections]
+                    self.assertCountEqual(resolved, expected)
+
+    def test_picture_views_are_valid_and_described(self):
+        path = SITE / "static/operation-paths.svg"
+        self.assertTrue(path.is_file(), "The reference toolpath pictures must ship with the site")
+        root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
+        self.assertEqual(root.tag, SVG + "svg")
+        views = {view.get("id"): view for view in root.findall(SVG + "view")}
+        kinds = {kind for family in FAMILIES.values() for kind in family}
+        self.assertEqual(set(views), kinds)
+        for kind, view in views.items():
+            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
+                numbers = [float(n) for n in view.attrib["viewBox"].split()]
+                self.assertEqual(len(numbers), 4)
+                self.assertGreater(numbers[2], 0)
+                self.assertGreater(numbers[3], 0)
+                group = root.find(f".//{SVG}g[@id='{kind}-diagram']")
+                self.assertIsNotNone(group, f"{kind} needs its visible drawing")
+                translation = re.fullmatch(r"translate\(([-\d.]+) ([-\d.]+)\)", group.get("transform", ""))
+                self.assertIsNotNone(translation, f"{kind} needs its view origin")
+                self.assertEqual([float(n) for n in translation.groups()], numbers[:2])
+                self.assertTrue(any(
+                    element.get("class") == "cut" for element in group.iter()

+    ]
+    .into_iter()
+    .map(|(directory, number)| format!("{directory}/{number}"))
+    .filter(|path| root.join(path).exists())
+    .collect();
+
+    assert!(
